Is your run club the new Love Island?
Strava's 2024 Year in Sport survey found nearly one in five Gen Z respondents had dated someone they met through exercise. That's a global survey, about exercise overall.
So we mapped 13 Sydney run clubs from public sources, and flagged the ones that meet outside the City of Sydney, like Bondi and Bronte.
Here's how the data moves: public club pages into one sourced table,
onto a map, into a short vertical reel.
What we don't claim: no love-odds score, and no local Microburbs demographic finding, because API access was blocked from our build machine.
Every figure has a source in the README. Thanks.
